opening.argument: The video identifies a Captain Marvel collectible figure and takes a closer look at what comes with it, including a gauntlet, interchangeable hands, and effects pieces. Its purchase information is straightforward: viewers are told they can preorder from a named retailer for $260. Those details support an ordinary product review and preorder, not a deceptive financial offer. The separate acknowledgment of Patreon supporters is an audience-support request, not part of the figure purchase. Nothing in the cited material establishes a loss or a deceptive outcome.
